ns2:course.label: Science Journalism
ns2:course.description: Students will explore media coverage of science. They will examine the interconnections of scientific advances and public understanding. Students will interview scientists and journalists, to discuss work, and to become science communicators. Subject matter of reporting projects will be determined by the background and interests of the students. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Journalism major(s) or minor(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
